message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/16560/figure_1a.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized finding scores for the PA view, specifically checking for patterns consistent with tracheobronchomegaly (Mounier-Kuhn) or cystic bronchiectasis (Williams-Campbell), though the classifier may not explicitly label these rare syndromes."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/16560/figure_1a.jpg", "reason": "To generate a descriptive report of the marked airway dilation and lung parenchyma to help distinguish between central airway enlargement (Mounier-Kuhn) and peripheral cartilage deficiency (Williams-Campbell)."}], "reason": "The question requires distinguishing between rare airway disorders based on radiological features in Figure 1a (PA) and 1b (Lateral).
